name: Productivity & Business
purpose: Track deep work, projects, tasks, and business income. Optimize work patterns.

key_features.name: Tasks Tab
key_features.description: Create, manage, and complete tasks with priorities and due dates

key_features.name: Projects Tab
key_features.description: Organize tasks into projects with progress tracking

key_features.name: Deep Work Sessions
key_features.description: Pomodoro-style focus sessions with duration and quality tracking

key_features.name: Plan Tomorrow Tab
key_features.description: Plan next day's tasks and time blocks the night before

key_features.name: Analytics
key_features.description: Charts showing productivity trends, completion rates, focus hours

data_tracked: Tasks (title, description, priority, due_date, status, project_id)
Deep work sessions (duration, quality_rating, task_id, notes)
related_modules: Calendar - Tasks appear as events when scheduled
Dashboard - Productivity score and task count shown
tips: Use 'Plan Tomorrow' the night before for better focus
Deep work sessions earn bonus XP
High priority tasks should be done during peak energy hours
